cards.label: Put on shoes
cards.imagePrompt: Flat vector icon, plain white background, no detail: a child's shoes with wide hook-and-loop straps, both straps open
cards.altText: A pair of shoes with wide straps that fasten without laces

cards.label: Musical dinosaur
cards.imagePrompt: Flat vector icon, plain white background, no detail: a toy dinosaur with music notes beside it
cards.altText: A toy dinosaur that plays music

script.phrase: First shoes on, then musical dinosaur.
One more strap, then musical dinosaur.
Shoes are on. Now the musical dinosaur!

promptHierarchy.instruction: Hold out the shoes, straps already open.
Hand-over-hand on the strap, briefly, then let go.

plan.reinforcement: Keep the musical dinosaur out of her reach and within yours. It comes out only after the shoes are on, and it comes out straight away.
plan.placement: By the front door, at the child's eye level, where the shoes are kept.
plan.boardAction: Both cards stay up from the start. When both shoes are fastened, take the shoes card off the board and point to the musical dinosaur card.
plan.generalization: Tying laces is the later goal, not this board. Work on it away from the morning, with no clock running, once shoes-on is easy.
plan.ifChallengingBehavior: Keep prompting the FIRST task. Fewer words, not louder ones. Stay on the shoes, not on the behaviour. Then still give the musical dinosaur.
